'''Madic''' was a servant that works in the Palace in [[Ebou Dar]]. He was also a [[Darkfriend]].

==Appearance==
He was balding and had a very smug atmosphere about himself.

==Activities==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] bribed him in the Palace to keep an eye out for [[Tylin Quintara Mitsobar]]. He later reported to [[Moridin]] about the [[Bowl of the Winds]] being found and taken from Ebou Dar. Moridin killed him in a rage and his remains were then eaten by the ''[[gholam]]''.
